title: ACC on principal ideals gives irreducible factorizations
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] integral domain. Then every nonzero nonunit $a\in R$ is a finite product $a=b_1\cdots b_k$ ($k\ge1$) of irreducible elements $b_i$ of $R$.
